svg.text: THE WHOLE UNDERGROUND: every district as one labyrinth, 252 m deep, from the Sewers (144) down to the Inner Sun (0) (a proposal)
north is up · a LAYOUT, not to scale inside a plot: one plot = 3 x 3 boxes
to The Woods (the shaft under Dead Man's Cave)
thread 8 holds it: its own plan
- - a FOUND way up (a climb, a trunk, a ladder)
┄ level ON PURPOSE (an open place, a fight place)
▒ a STAIR (real stair pieces cut in the face; walked both ways)

A LAYOUT: one plot = 3 x 3 boxes (not battle squares). The number is the LEVEL (1 level = 1.75 m) ABOVE THE INNER SUN: the Sewers under the city are 144 (252 m up), the Inner Sun is 0. ORANGE BAR = a climb, both ways (ladder, stair). WHITE
BAR with a tooth = a cliff or a waterfall, DOWN only. Orange dots = the ways in from the surface and from Hell. Each district is entered at its top and goes down as you go in. A PROPOSAL.
